items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Fergie; the name 'Fergie' is only mentioned by the interviewer in the context of starting a meal.

ctx.x: He never stops. I'm not worried about that. I'll drop in and see him once in a while, Dick. If you don't play like his brother, you don't play it right. He tells the guys what he wants when he has it. Dick, when he has a record made. D dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…

I got the fifth reel going. Anyway, Fergie. So let's eat. How about it? Yeah, alright. We'll eat. But I was going to ask you about the four of trumpet and mouthpieces, the type of mouthpiece you use. What do the other guys use?
